definitions: A group of people organized for a common purpose.
A military unit composed of several regiments (or battalions) and including soldiers from different arms of service.
To form or unite into a brigade; to group together.
To harass an individual or community online in a coordinated manner.

blocks.text: A brigade is a major tactical military formation that typically comprises three to six battalions plus supporting elements. It is roughly equivalent to an enlarged or reinforced regiment. Two or more brigades may constitute a division.

Brigade are a British alternative rock band from London, England, formed in 2003. The four-piece consisted of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Will Simpson, lead guitarist and backing vocalist James Plant, bassist Naoto Hori, and drummer Andrew Kearton.

images.alt: A U.S. infantry brigade of around 3,200 personnel, formed into eight battalion-sized groups
